lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn10Cr2N12 (reduced formula Mn5CrN6) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for all N and Mn centers, and for Cr centers, with each N and Mn environment surrounded by six neighbors of the other element. The octahedra display corner- and edge-sharing relations among N-centered octahedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
